      "id": 	"s1",
      "title": "Dat bien va lap phuong trinh",
      "explanation": "Goi chieu rong la x (m), thi chieu dai la x+5 (m). Dien tich hinh chu nhat la tich chieu rong va chieu dai, nen ta co phuong trinh x(x+5)=84.",

      "geometryActions": []
    },

      "id": 	"s2",
      "title": "Giai phuong trinh bac hai",
      "explanation": "Mo rong va ve ve dang chuan, sau do tinh delta va ap dung cong thuc nghiem.",
      "math": "\\begin{aligned}\n&x^2+5x-84=0\\\\\n&\\Delta = 5^2 - 4\\cdot1\\cdot(-84)=25+336=361=19^2\\\\\n&x = \\frac{-5 \\pm 19}{2}\n\\end{aligned}",

      "geometryActions": []
    },

      "id": 	"s3",

      "math": "x_1=7,\\ x_2=-12 \\Rightarrow x=7\\text{ m}\\\\ \\text{chieu dai}=x+5=12\\text{ m}",
      "reason": "Dieu kien do dai duong",
      "geometryActions": []
    }
